Frequently Asked Questions

Which Apkina lights support app control?+

AP3250, AP620, AP1000 and the 300W Bi-Colour Video Light list app control in their specifications.

Which lights have a built-in battery?+

AP475, AP3150, AP3250, AP620 and AP1000 have built-in batteries. The AP336 accepts compatible F-series batteries or 9V/3A DC power. The 300W studio light uses AC power.

Which batteries can the charger charge?+

The supplied charger is described as compatible with Sony NP-F series batteries, including NP-F970. Confirm the exact battery and charger configuration before use.

Are accessories included?+

Check the included accessories for your selected configuration. Light modifiers shown with the 300W reference are not included. Tripod head, height and carry-bag inclusion can vary.

Can I order products here?+

This website is an information catalogue, with product details and specification downloads. It does not accept orders or payments.
